# scale maximum

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:scaleMax`](gmeow-scaleMax.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/scaleMax>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/norms`](../../slices/norms.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The scale's maximum value. Functional and mandatory; must exceed the minimum (SHACL).

## Structure

**Property shape:** datatype property; [`gmeow:ScoreScale`](../classes/gmeow-ScoreScale.md) -> [`xsd:decimal`](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#decimal); functional

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:scaleMax`](gmeow-scaleMax.md) from [`gmeow:ScoreScale`](../classes/gmeow-ScoreScale.md) to [`xsd:decimal`](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#decimal) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to set the upper bound of a score scale.

### Avoid when

- Avoid omitting it or giving more than one (it is functional and mandatory) and avoid a maximum at or below the minimum (SHACL requires max > min).

### How to use

- Assert [`gmeow:scaleMax`](gmeow-scaleMax.md) once per [`gmeow:ScoreScale`](../classes/gmeow-ScoreScale.md), paired with a strictly smaller [`gmeow:scaleMin`](gmeow-scaleMin.md).

### Examples

- ex:zeroToOne [`gmeow:scaleMax`](gmeow-scaleMax.md) 1.0.
